answer: Plume Quota Auction. Each agent identity must hold a periodically auctioned coordination slot to act; the clearing price floats with the number of active slots, and unused slots lapse. A forged identity therefore pays the full rising slot price plus a forfeited deposit when it fails to submit a valid activity signal. Because slot supply is capped per epoch, an attacker buying N identities pays a superlinear auction premium, and idle sybils waste that spend as timber decays.
